title: Jackpot.com Review
contentHtml:
Visit Jackpot.com

Ease of Use

Jackpot.com is a very simple, easy to use online lottery site. It features a clean, minimalist aesthetic that is devoid of clutter and ads. This is a pretty professional-looking site. In terms of playing, you basically only need to follow these three steps:
  1. Upon landing on their front page, you can immediately see the games on offer. From there you simply choose which lottery you want to participate in and click the “Pick” button. As of this writing, Jackpot.com offers 19 lottery games, such as the US Powerball, US Mega Millions, Australia Powerball, and the like. Very soon, they will be adding the 20th game to their repertoire, so stay tuned!
  2. Once you choose the lottery game you want to play, you can select your numbers, or click on the quick-pick button up top in order to get a randomly selected set of numbers. You can keep on clicking this button until you get a set that you are happy with. Another thing worth noting is that you can also choose to subscribe to every draw so you don’t miss out. Your choice.
  3. Finally, you just hit the “Play” button in order to add your selections to the checkout. Not to be cliché, but it really is as easy as 1-2-3.
After playing your numbers, all you need to do is to wait to see if you win. Like other online lottery sites, you can simply keep on visiting the results page to see if you have won anything. Even better, you can choose to sign up for Jackpot.com’s free results alerts. These alerts can either be automatically sent to you via email or text. If you want to stop certain alerts, you can easily do so by unselecting them via the Alerts section of your account.  

Payments

In terms of payment methods, Jackpot.com accepts Visa, Mastercard, Skrill, NETeller, Abaqoos, Astro, Pboleto, DineroMail, EPS, and many more. In total, they accept a whopping 31 different payment methods. As for withdrawal methods, it is a shame that they only accept Visa and Mastercard. All is not lost, however. Jackpot.com has stated that they will be adding Paysafecard, Fonix, and direct bank transfers in the near future.  

Player Protection

Playing the lottery can prove to be addicting for some, which is why Jackpot.com takes certain steps to ensure that players use the site in a responsible way. For starters, each player is asked to enter a maximum daily spend limit upon registering. This way, you get to control your spending each day so you won’t end up just buying a ticket after ticket. Next, you can also choose to temporarily suspend your account for a predetermined period of time, effectively giving you a “time out” from playing the lottery. Finally, Jackpot.com also takes certain steps to age-verify each member that signs up in order to keep those under the age of 18 from playing. All in all, the site does a wonderful job of promoting responsible playing.  

Subscriptions

Initially, Jackpot.com didn’t allow players to purchase subscriptions to their favorite lottery games, but they have since added this feature. In addition, you can change your numbers or cancel subscriptions at any time. If you don’t want to purchase a continuous subscription, Jackpot.com also offers multi draws.  

Side Games

Recently, Jackpot.com also added a ton of side games for a much-needed dose of variety. These include more than 20 different scratch cards, bingo, keno, and virtual slots, making them on par with a lot of other lottery sites.  

Promotions

On top of all the other features, Jackpot.com also offers constant promotions every week. Plus, they also have a nearly 60% off discount for Powerball, Mega Millions, Irish Lotto, and EuroMillions monthly subscriptions, which would set you back €9.99/mo. each.  

Customer Support

Jackpot.com has a pretty good customer support offering. For starters, their Help Center is pretty comprehensive and should answer just about any question you may have about their service. In case you need one-on-one assistance, you can also contact them via live chat, phone, email, Whatsapp, and Facebook messenger. They are also pretty active on social media, so you can try reaching out to them there as well. And if you are a newcomer, they also offer a How to Play section to help ease you into the lottery experience.  
Visit Jackpot.com
